$comment: The one source for colour, type and spacing of the workshop books: each teaching repository's attendee workbook and facilitator guide. Copied into each repository as design/tokens.json, because those repositories are public and standalone. Colours were sampled from clickhouse.com's own stylesheets on 2026-09-19; the name beside each is theirs. Yellow is a fill, never text on paper.

card.use: a raised block: a diagram, a table, a command

ink-2.use: the opening line of a chapter

faint.use: figure numbers. Large or bold only

accent.use: a fill only, with ink on top: the one marked box in a diagram, a highlight bar. Never text on paper

accent-deep.use: text or a rule that has to be yellow-toned on paper

fill-dark.use: the one dark box in a diagram, and command blocks on screen. Paper text on top

fail.use: it was refused or it broke

contrast.$comment: Every pair a page renders, with the level it must reach. The test computes the ratio. A text, state or fill colour that appears in no pair is one nobody checked.

sans.use: headings and body. There is no serif in this system

page.$comment: Print geometry, in millimetres. One column, 174 wide, so heading, picture, caption and text share one left edge. 174 is 493pt and the diagram canvas is 504 units wide, so one unit prints at 0.98pt: text set at 11 prints at 10.8pt.
